title: Module 6 Website Studio
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting module 6 website studio to GitHub Pages file tree with accessibility, privacy, and publishing checks, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Verify an integrated published artifact on its live URL, distinguishing a clean commit history from a clean latest snapshot, and explain why integration testing catches failures that per-section checks miss.

Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it.
